meetings.title: Meetings
detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the meeting and all associated managed files?
detail.closeDirtyConfirm: Close the meeting without saving speaker changes?
summary.stale: The minutes were created from an older transcript or speaker list. The last successful result is kept; consider re-running summarization.
speakers.empty: Speakers appear after the transcription stage is enabled.
speakers.noAudio: The source audio stream is unavailable for this recording.
speakers.oldFragments: Fragments from older processing are unavailable. Re-run diarization for drag & drop.
speakers.dragTitle: Drag onto another card to merge
speakers.help: Edit all names, move fragments between cards, or drag one speaker card onto another to merge. Changes apply only after a common save.
speakers.cantMove: Cannot move fragments between microphone and system streams
speakers.cantMerge: Cannot merge microphone and system streams
speakers.saved: All speaker changes saved; transcript updated
artifacts.deleteConfirm: Delete file “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
import.hint: Audio is automatically converted to working PCM16 mono 16 kHz. The source file is not kept after successful validation. Microphone and system audio can be uploaded sequentially; a mixed import replaces the separate pair.
jobs.participantsHint: Including the microphone owner. 0 — detect automatically; system.wav uses N−1.
jobs.audioHint: If an old meeting only has Opus or MP3 left, LocalMeetAssist automatically restores working PCM16 WAV on reprocessing. The compressed source is kept.
jobs.cancelConfirm: Stop the current processing? Already created intermediate files and source WAVs will be kept.
jobs.participantsSaved: Participant count saved for the meeting
jobs.participantsError: Enter an integer number of participants from 0 to 65
models.title: Models
models.meta: ONNX Runtime and models are downloaded separately. LocalMeetAssist calls them directly — no CLI, Python, or GigaAMGUI.
models.group.runtime.title: Runtime
models.group.runtime.desc: Native ONNX Runtime and whisper.cpp for the current OS and architecture. LocalMeetAssist loads the libraries directly — no separate CLIs needed.
models.group.transcription.title: Speech-to-text
models.group.transcription.desc: GigaAM v3 is best for Russian speech; Whisper small is faster, medium is more accurate, and large-v3-turbo gives the highest quality of the offered options.
models.group.speech_filter.title: Speech filtering
models.group.speech_filter.desc: Silero VAD separates speech from silence and splits a long meeting into short stable fragments.
models.group.diarization.title: Speaker identification
models.group.diarization.desc: PyAnnote finds local speech tracks, WeSpeaker compares voices, and LocalMeetAssist merges them using the meeting participant count.
settings.title: Settings
settings.meta: Working settings apply immediately. Server address, data/log directories and DB — after restart.
settings.savedToast: Settings saved and applied without restart.
settings.savedToastRestart: Working settings applied immediately; system settings require restart.
settings.testing: Testing connection and short test generation…
settings.secretSet: Saved — enter a new one to replace
settings.duplicateHotkey: Shortcut {value} is already assigned to another action

integrations.auditEnableDesc: Records integration-token requests: time, token, IP, method and result. Stored in a separate log file.
integrations.portRestart: Port {port} is saved, but the application is still running on port {current}. Restart LocalMeetAssist for the change to take effect.
integrations.tokenCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the token manually.
integrations.auditEmpty: No audit entries (audit is off or there have been no requests yet).
